{"code_block": "import requests, json, sys, time

# Define page title and API URL
page_title = "Outer_Wilds"
api_url = "https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php"

# Parameters: we want to fetch all revisions older than 2019-05-01T00:00:00Z
params = {
    "action": "query",
    "format": "json",
    "prop": "revisions",
    "titles": page_title,
    "rvlimit": "max",  # maximum per request
    "rvdir": "older",  # order: older revisions (going backwards from start timestamp)
    "rvstart": "2019-05-01T00:00:00Z",  # start timestamp (newest to start from)
    "rvprop": "ids|timestamp",
}

count = 0
continue_params = params.copy()
# We'll loop while there are revisions
while True:
    resp = requests.get(api_url, params=continue_params)
    data = resp.json()
    # Navigate to revisions list
    pages = data.get("query", {}).get("pages", {})
    # There should be only one page, get its revisions
    revisions = None
    for page_id, pageinfo in pages.items():
        revs = pageinfo.get("revisions")
        if revs is not None:
            revisions = revs
            break
    if not revisions:
        # no more revisions
        break
    count += len(revisions)
    # Check for continuation
    cont = data.get("continue")
    if cont:
        continue_params.update(cont)
    else:
        break
    time.sleep(0.1)  # be nice to the server
print("Total revisions older than 2019-05-01:", count)
